basic_details.job_title: Zila Panchayat Bilaspur Computer Programmer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline

age_limit.details: The age limit and related provisions are governed by the Chhattisgarh Government General Administration Department orders issued vide letter dated 16.09.2026 (Rule 38 revised to 45 years for government servants, corporation, board, municipal corporations, and municipal council employees working in government service). The age calculation shall be reckoned as on 01 January 2026.

qualification.details: Candidates must be native residents of Chhattisgarh.

how_to_apply: Download the official application form and notification from the official website bilaspur.gov.in.
Fill out the application form in the prescribed format.
Enclose self-attested copies of all required educational qualification certificates, experience certificates, and recent passport-size photographs.
Place the application form in a closed envelope and clearly superscribe the name of the post on top of the envelope.
Send the completed application by Registered Post or Speed Post to the Chief Executive Officer, Zila Panchayat Bilaspur, Viksit Bharat-Rozgar aur Aajivika ke liye Guarantee Mission (Gramin).
Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 23 October 2026 by 05:30 PM.
important_instructions: Applications received directly by hand or after the closing date and time will not be entertained. Applicants currently working in government service, corporations, boards, or municipal councils must submit their application through proper channel along with a No Objection Certificate (NOC). Incomplete, unclear, or defective applications will be summarily rejected without separate notification. Contract appointment will be valid up to 28 February 2027, subject to extension based on work performance, capacity, and annual performance appraisal. Candidates must attach recent photos and self-attested mark sheets, failing which the application will be cancelled. If the number of received applications is high, candidates will be called for a skill test / interview in the ratio of 1:10 against the vacancy based on merit.

content_sections.heading: Zila Panchayat Bilaspur Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age limit and related provisions are governed by the Chhattisgarh Government General Administration Department orders issued vide letter dated 16.09.2026 (Rule 38 revised to 45 years for government servants, corporation, board, municipal corporations, and municipal council employees working in government service). The age calculation shall be reckoned as on 01 January 2026.

content_sections.heading: Zila Panchayat Bilaspur Salary
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any additional allowances or benefits apart from the consolidated monthly remuneration.

content_sections.heading: Zila Panchayat Bilaspur Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of merit calculation based on educational qualification percentage, a computer or practical test, and work experience. Weightage on percentage of marks in minimum required educational qualification: Up to 70 marks. Computer or practical test (Knowledge of Data Net Technologies / Java / MS SQL / Oracle): 15 marks. Work experience in government rural development projects at least equal to regular pay: Up to 5 marks (5 marks for up to 2 years experience, 10 marks for experience beyond 2 years).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Zila Panchayat Bilaspur Computer Programmer Recruitment
content_sections.text: Download the official application form and notification from the official website bilaspur.gov.in. Fill out the application form in the prescribed format. Enclose self-attested copies of all required educational qualification certificates, experience certificates, and recent passport-size photographs. Place the application form in a closed envelope and clearly superscribe the name of the post on top of the envelope. Send the completed application by Registered Post or Speed Post to the Chief Executive Officer, Zila Panchayat Bilaspur, Viksit Bharat-Rozgar aur Aajivika ke liye Guarantee Mission (Gramin). Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 23 October 2026 by 05:30 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of educational mark sheets and degree certificates Chhattisgarh domicile certificate Experience certificate (if applicable) Recent passport-size photograph Caste certificate (if applicable)

content_sections.text: Applications received directly by hand or after the closing date and time will not be entertained. Applicants currently working in government service, corporations, boards, or municipal councils must submit their application through proper channel along with a No Objection Certificate (NOC). Incomplete, unclear, or defective applications will be summarily rejected without separate notification. Contract appointment will be valid up to 28 February 2027, subject to extension based on work performance, capacity, and annual performance appraisal. Candidates must attach recent photos and self-attested mark sheets, failing which the application will be cancelled. If the number of received applications is high, candidates will be called for a skill test / interview in the ratio of 1:10 against the vacancy based on merit.

faq.question: Q1. What is Zila Panchayat Bilaspur Computer Programmer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification released by Zila Panchayat Bilaspur to fill 1 Computer Programmer vacancy on a contract basis under Viksit Bharat-Ji Ram Ji Yojana.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Computer Programmer post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 23 October 2026 up to 05:30 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a First Division B.E Computer Science, MCA, M.Sc (Computer Science), or B.E (IT).

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is governed by Chhattisgarh government norms, including relaxations up to 45 years for government/corportation/board employees as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply offline by sending the filled application form via Registered Post or Speed Post to the office of the Chief Executive Officer, Zila Panchayat Bilaspur.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process includes weightage on educational qualification percentage, a computer practical test, and work experience.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 51,780/-.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, this appointment is made on a contract basis until 28 February 2027, with provisions for extension based on performance evaluation.
